intro: Each morning at breakfast, our staff will ask you what you’d like for lunch and dinner. Instead of a fixed menu, we offer an ever-changing selection of approximately 10-14 dishes, inspired by our large repertoire of international cuisine. Drawing from Bali and Indonesia’s rich flavors, as well as Thai, Chinese, Japanese, Western, Italian, Mediterranean, Indian, and Middle Eastern recipes, we craft fresh, seasonal dishes based on what’s coming out of our gardens and what we’ve sourced from local markets. Enjoy a diverse, flavorful journey every day in a relaxed, authentic setting.
Please note our staff will take your order in the morning.
